turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We currently do not ship to countries outside the United States and Canada.

Here is how it works by region:

Contiguous United States: We ship all products throughout the lower 48 states.
Alaska & Hawaii: We ship select products; shipping is $25 per item.
Canada (limited regions): We ship select items seasonally.

Regarding customs, duties, and taxes for Canada:

All Canadian prices are listed in CAD and already include all duties and taxes in the price you see at checkout, so there are no extra customs or duty fees on delivery.

If you are outside the US/Canada but want to ship to a US address and your international billing address is not accepted at checkout, please contact our customer care team at info@heirloomroses.com or call (800) 820-0465 (Monday–Friday 6:00AM–4:00PM and Saturday 8:00AM–4:00PM PST).

turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Standard shipping does not have a single set number of days, because we time it around the delivery date you choose at checkout.

Here’s how it works:

• United States: At checkout you’ll see a delivery calendar and can pick an estimated arrival date. We calculate that based on the time needed to prepare your plants plus standard carrier transit time to your address.

• Canada (where eligible): At checkout you choose a ship week instead of a specific day. Orders are prepared and shipped that week, then go through customs and are delivered via FedEx 2‑day from the border. Delivery timing is still estimated.

All delivery dates are estimates, since things like weather and carrier delays can affect transit. The easiest way to see the timing for you is to add items to your cart and go to checkout; after you enter your address, the available dates for standard shipping will appear for your location.
